explanationMd: Multiplying exponents gives a to the sixth in the numerator. Dividing by a squared subtracts two from six, giving a to the fourth. Positivity makes the fractional power well defined.

distractorRationale.b: This does not apply the power-of-a-power rule.
distractorRationale.a: The outer power multiplies the inner exponent before the division.
distractorRationale.d: Division requires subtracting, not adding, the denominator exponent.
